parameters.repair_trigger: 8-connected component count greater than 1 for a single manual stroke
parameters.corridor: shortest 2-px bridge between disconnected stroke components before skeletonization
parameters.gap_closure: only near-foreground route gap pixels needed for component contact; recorded per repair
parameters.vector_smoothing: gaussian sigma 1.20 followed by bounded quadratic-midpoint centreline (centerline-quadratic-v1)
